descriptions.Groceries: Food and drink from grocery stores and supermarkets, for eating at home. Takeout, restaurants and coffee shops are Dining Out.
descriptions.Dining Out: Restaurants, fast food, takeout, food delivery, coffee shops and treats eaten out.
descriptions.Shopping: Amazon orders and general wants: electronics, hobbies, books, games and things for fun. A gift bought for a birthday, holiday or other event goes here too, unless a person picks the event's fund.
descriptions.Household & Kids: Running the home and caring for the kids: toiletries, cleaning supplies, clothing and shoes, diapers, and school and kids' supplies.
descriptions.Gas & Transport: Fuel, parking, tolls, rideshare and transit fares.
descriptions.Reimbursement: Work or other expenses that someone will pay back, such as work travel or purchases made on someone else's behalf.
